documents.effective_date_basis: General commencement of these provisions; exceptions and amendments retain their provision-level dates. Not a current-law guarantee.
documents.scope_note: GB employer-consultation requirements under regulations 3–16 only, including listed changes, excluded schemes/employers, and conditional consultation timing. Regulation 22 has separate NI extent. This source is not used to establish amendment powers, accrued-rights protection, consent or a specific change outcome.

documents.title: The Occupational Pension Schemes (Modification of Schemes) Regulations 2006
documents.effective_date_basis: General commencement of these provisions; exceptions and amendments retain their provision-level dates. Not a current-law guarantee.
documents.scope_note: GB occupational-scheme modification and subsisting-rights framework only: prescribed exemptions, actuarial-equivalence requirements and specified trustee powers. This source does not establish employer-consultation or personal-pension rules. Specific conclusions require scheme powers, facts, amendments and provision-level commencement.

documents.title: Pensions Act 1995 — section 67
documents.effective_date_basis: General commencement of these provisions; exceptions and amendments retain their provision-level dates. Not a current-law guarantee.
documents.scope_note: GB occupational pension subsisting-rights framework under section 67 only: prohibited and regulated modifications, consent or actuarial-equivalence routes, trustee approval, reporting and exceptions. It does not supply employer-consultation thresholds or personal-pension rules. Application requires sections 67A–67I, amendments and specific scheme facts.
